It is also construct-bound: the word points forward to {{ar:مِرَّةٍۢ}} ({{tr:mirratin}}), making the bearer known through the quality borne rather than through an independent title. The familiar elevated {{ar:ذُو}} ({{tr:dhū}})-attribute pattern gives the quality a defining weight, while the comparison with {{ar:ذُو ٱلْجَلَـٰل}} ({{tr:dhū l-jalāl}}) (55:27; 55:78) remains a template echo, not an identity claim. Structurally the word keeps 53:6 in portrait mode for one more beat before the following verb turns description into action.

words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the ayah's hinge: it both connects backward to the completed portrait and launches the verbal clause that follows. Its immediate-sequence force makes the move from {{ar:ذُو مِرَّةٍۢ}} ({{tr:dhū mirratin}}) to {{ar:ٱسْتَوَىٰ}} ({{tr:istawā}}) feel immediate, and the local context lets consequence ride with sequence: the borne vigor issues into positioning. Because the particle is graphically and recitationally fused to the verb as {{ar:فَٱسْتَوَىٰ}} ({{tr:fa-stawā}}), the transition is heard as a quick, continuous turn from description into action rather than as a detached new report.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱسْتَوَىٰ}} ({{tr:istawā}}) is the first finite action after the portrait, and its perfect tense makes the positioning arrive as an accomplished landing. Because it appears without {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:alā}}), the local frame does not name an object mounted upon; the throne-formula recurrence with {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:alā}}) (7:54; 10:3; 20:5; 25:59) sharpens that absence rather than importing the full formula here. As Form X from {{ar:س و ي}} ({{tr:s-w-y}}), the verb carries achieved evenness and self-establishment: the subject reaches a stable configuration instead of being fashioned as an object by another form such as {{ar:سَوَّى}} ({{tr:sawwā}}). The hidden 3ms subject is recovered from the prior epithet chain, so the vigor described in 53:5-6 culminates in this settled act, while the exact spatial location remains open until the highest-horizon phrase in 53:7.

topics.headline: Form X makes balance self-achieved
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the action as the subject's own movement into balanced establishment, not a passive state or transitive fashioning.
topics.reason: The Form X perfect is intransitive here, while the root field includes transitive fashioning forms; that contrast preserves self-establishment as the local payoff.

topics.reason: The 3ms agreement has no overt noun in the clause; attachment evidence strongly licenses recovery from the prior descriptive chain, while the wording should avoid overclaiming beyond that local resolution.

topics.headline: perfect verb lands the portrait in action

topics.reason: {{ar:ٱسْتَوَىٰ}} ({{tr:istawā}}) is a perfect 3ms verb and closes the verbal clause, making it the completed event after the nominal buildup.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessed quality in مِرَّةٍ is followed resultatively by فاستوى.
baseline_models.mechanism: Mirra supplies both firmly twisted cohesion and resolved strength; istawa converts that gathered capacity into sound, completed poise. The sequence is force becoming self-governed form, not two unrelated compliments.

activation_trace.role: Firmly twisted strands supply an image of internally integrated capacity.
Bodily and mental firmness makes that integration an agentive power and resolve.
Straightening into sound completion supplies the result reached by the gathered power.
Attained maturity makes istawa the completion of capacity rather than mere posture.

changed_reading.before: A powerful being then stood upright.
changed_reading.after: A bearer of tightly integrated power brought that capacity into mature, internally sound poise.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The motion potential of مِرَّةٍ and the directional and stationing senses of فاستوى form a focus-internal trajectory.
baseline_models.mechanism: Mirra can carry passage along a route, while istawa can turn toward a direction and rise into a settled station. The clause can therefore render controlled transit ending in intentional placement.

activation_trace.role: Passage through a route supplies the trajectory latent in the possessed quality.
Directed turning supplies an intended destination for that passage.
Rising and settling supplies the terminal station of the movement.

changed_reading.before: The verse gives a static quality and a static stance.
changed_reading.after: The verse compresses a trajectory: capable passage, deliberate orientation, then occupation of a station.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The rope sense of مِرَّةٍ and the balancing senses of استوى remain attached to the two lexical centers of 53:6.
baseline_models.mechanism: A strongly twisted cord does not eliminate opposed pulls; it distributes them. Equality and an even midpoint let istawa name the equilibrium produced by held tension, making strength a relation among forces rather than sheer magnitude.

activation_trace.role: The compacted cord supplies multiple force-bearing strands under tension.
Equivalence supplies balanced loading across those strands.
An even midpoint supplies the stable geometry generated by the balance.

changed_reading.before: Strength means an excess of force.
changed_reading.after: Strength is force held in an even tensile relation, and istawa is the achieved equilibrium.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مِرَّةٍ can activate bitterness and severe ordeal, while استوى can mark straightness after distortion.
baseline_models.mechanism: The possessed mirra can be the capacity formed in bitter severity; fa-istawa then marks recovery into sound composure. The reading treats harshness as material processed into stability, not as cruelty projected outward.

activation_trace.role: Bitter taste supplies an inwardly undergone harshness.
Severe adversity enlarges bitterness into an ordeal that can form resolve.
Restored straightness supplies the composure reached after the ordeal.

changed_reading.before: The quality is simply formidable strength.
changed_reading.after: The quality may be ordeal-tempered firmness whose visible outcome is recovered soundness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding intensified powers activate the cable structure already latent in mirra: bonds and several gathered strands become one capacity, and fa-istawa reads as their coordinated stabilization.

activation_trace.role: The focus cord image provides the integrative structure for power.
Focus completion provides the resulting stable state.
Binding a knot contributes the act that keeps plural capacities joined.
Convergent rope-like force makes the plural powers function as load-sharing strands.

structural_cues: 53:5 places teaching by the intensely powerful immediately before ذو مرة, and the fa- of فاستوى presents a consequent state.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies knotting, rope-strand force, mirra, and completion; I infer that the several powers converge and thereby stabilize. A live alternative is simple synonymous intensification with no cable-like causality.

changed_reading.after: Mirra denotes coordinated, load-sharing powers whose integration yields stable completion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exclusion of subjective pull, the concealed delivery of knowledge, and teaching recast mirra as cognitive self-command and istawa as alignment of a transmission channel. Power here preserves a message from distortion.

activation_trace.role: Strong mind and resolve supply resistance to distorting pressure.
Internal straightness supplies fidelity in the resulting alignment.
Inclination of the self supplies the explicitly excluded source of directional distortion.
Quiet imparting of knowledge supplies the content that must cross the channel intact.
Knowledge becoming disclosed to a knower supplies the successful endpoint of transmission.

structural_cues: 53:3-6 forms a sequence from speech not sourced in desire, through revelation and teaching, to the possessor of mirra becoming aligned.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies subjective inclination, hidden imparting, disclosure, and focus straightness; I infer a fidelity-preserving channel. The materially live alternative is that 53:6 describes only the teacher's body or location.

changed_reading.before: The subject is strong and stands composed.
changed_reading.after: The subject's strength is disciplined fidelity: an imparted disclosure is carried into alignment without being bent by inclination.

context_deltas.mechanism: Horizon, height, descent, nearness, and measured bow-span turn istawa from generic uprightness into exact stationing in a coordinate field. The station is a controlled transition point that makes approach possible.

activation_trace.role: Firm self-command supplies control through the spatial transition.
Rising and settling supplies occupation of an exact station.
Remote horizons provide the lateral coordinate of the station.
Elevation provides its vertical coordinate.
Approach makes the station operational rather than merely scenic.
Descent from above supplies the controlled vector leaving the station.
Measurement by comparison supplies calibration of the resulting proximity.

structural_cues: 53:6-9 moves from istawa to the upper horizon, then approach and descent, and finally a dual measured distance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies coordinates, vertical movement, approach, and measure; I infer that istawa is the staging condition for the controlled approach. An alternative is a simple narrative sequence with no causal role for the station.

changed_reading.before: Istawa means that the subject stood upright.
changed_reading.after: Istawa marks exact high stationing from which a measured descent and approach can be executed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus cord, the preceding powers figured as rope-like units, and the later bow and leveling-line inventory form a material analogy: opposing tensile loads produce an even relation. The dual bows make istawa legible as symmetric force geometry.

activation_trace.role: The focus cord supplies a tension-bearing material substrate.
Equality supplies the balanced relation among tensile loads.
Plural capacities gathered like rope strands supply distributed force.
The bow supplies the curved implement in which stored tension becomes directed capacity.
A common leveling cord supplies an image of separate bodies aligned to one line.

structural_cues: 53:5 names plural powers, 53:6 joins cord-like mirra to equality-capable istawa, and 53:9 presents two bows as a measured pair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rope-strand force, a twisted cord, a bow, a leveling line, and equality; I supply the shared mechanics of tensile balance. The live alternative is that the bow phrase measures distance only and activates no material model.

changed_reading.before: The power is a single undifferentiated magnitude.
changed_reading.after: The power behaves like a tuned tensile system: several loads become one directed and symmetric capacity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The temporal-occurrence branch of mirra is awakened by a witnessed single descent explicitly marked as another. Istawa can then be eventive: the subject has the capacity to recur and take the station again, not merely an intrinsic stock of strength.

activation_trace.role: A countable occurrence supplies the evental rather than purely qualitative reading of mirra.
Settling into a station supplies the repeatable event's completion.
Actual sighting makes recurrence an observed manifestation rather than an abstract cycle.
A single descent supplies a bounded, countable episode.
Lateness relative to a first event explicitly establishes recurrence.

structural_cues: 53:11-13 repeats seeing language and culminates in an explicitly other descent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a focus occurrence branch plus one descent marked as subsequent; I infer that mirra can characterize repeatable manifestation and istawa its renewed stationing. The stronger grammatical alternative keeps mirra as strength and assigns recurrence only to seeing.

changed_reading.before: Mirra is a permanent attribute possessed by the subject.
changed_reading.after: Mirra may also pulse eventally: a capacity to manifest again and re-assume a completed station.

context_deltas.mechanism: The non-falsifying heart and the eye that neither deviates nor exceeds its boundary make focus strength a governance of faculties. Istawa is calibrated perception under intensity: straight enough not to veer, bounded enough not to overreach.

activation_trace.role: Strength of mind and self-command supplies governance of the perceiving faculties.
Internal straightness supplies undistorted calibration.
The heart as inward heat supplies an intense interior faculty that nevertheless remains truthful.
Joined ocular and inward seeing supplies the perception being governed.
Departure from straightness supplies the first failure mode explicitly negated.
Eyesight supplies the embodied faculty on which calibration is tested.
Crossing a limit supplies the opposite failure mode, excessive reach.

structural_cues: 53:11 and 53:17 use paired negations around heart, sight, deviation, and excess before 53:18 affirms the seeing of great signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inward heat, sight, deviation, boundary excess, and focus self-command; I infer a regulatory mechanism linking mirra to perceptual fidelity. A live alternative treats the later negations as independent validation, not an unpacking of 53:6.

changed_reading.before: Strength prepares the subject physically for a vision.
changed_reading.after: Strength is also perceptual governance, holding heart and eye between distortion and overreach.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later endpoint and covering revise completion into threshold poise. Istawa need not mean exhaustive arrival into transparency; it can be the stable occupation of a limit where flow settles and what lies beyond remains veiled.

activation_trace.role: Resolve supplies the capacity to remain composed at a limit.
Settled elevation supplies stable occupation rather than penetration beyond the boundary.
Presence beside something supplies adjacency to the threshold rather than identity with what is beyond it.
A terminal limit supplies the boundary at which the station is taken.
Water settling where a torrent ends supplies a material analogy for motion becoming poised at its limit.
An overlying cover preserves concealment even at the achieved station.

structural_cues: 53:14-16 repeatedly locates the encounter at an endpoint and then stresses that the site is covered by what covers it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, endpoint, terminal settling, and cover; I infer that istawa is stable threshold occupation under partial concealment. The alternative is ordinary location followed by an unrelated description of the tree.

changed_reading.before: Completion means unrestricted arrival and full exposure.
changed_reading.after: Completion can mean poise exactly at a terminal boundary, stable even while the beyond remains covered.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence of elevation, descent, and servanthood, together with the final command to prostrate, reverses a dominance reading. Mirra becomes power capable of controlled lowering; istawa is mastery of posture in service, not self-exalting fixity.

activation_trace.role: Firm resolve supplies power that can be deliberately governed rather than merely displayed.
Rising and settling supplies a posture whose direction can subsequently reverse without loss of control.
Elevation supplies the upper pole of the reversible movement.
Descent from height demonstrates controlled lowering after elevation.
Submissive obedience supplies the relational purpose that governs the movement.

structural_cues: The local sequence rises at 53:7 and lowers at 53:8; the surah closes at 53:62 by commanding bodily lowering and worship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies height, controlled descent, servanthood, and the closing prostration; I infer that true focus strength includes reversible, obedient lowering. The live alternative is that the subject's movement and the audience's final posture are narratively separate.

changed_reading.before: The strong subject's istawa signals superior elevation.
changed_reading.after: The strong subject models governed power: able to rise, settle, and lower in obedience without becoming unstable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the bodily-humor sense of mirra rather than the expected strength sense. It remains anchored in the exact focus noun and its movement into bodily soundness, with heart and sight providing coexisting somatic faculties. Render only as a physiological analogy, not as a claim that the subject is ill or literally bilious.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The bodily-humor branch of مِرَّةٍ can combine with the sound-formation branch of استوى.

activation_trace.role: Bile or bodily humor supplies a concrete internal composition requiring regulation.
Sound internal formation supplies balance of that composition.
The inwardly heated heart supplies one embodied faculty within the regulated system.
Eyesight supplies another embodied faculty whose steadiness manifests the balance.

changed_reading.after: As a contained somatic analogy, mirra can be an internal temperament brought into sound balance and expressed as stable perception.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it temporarily shifts the clause from personal description to a cosmographic event by activating the rare lunar-evenness branch of istawa. It remains anchored in focus temporality and leveling and is triggered by star, fall, and horizon imagery. Render as an overlay on the personal reading, never as a confident identification of the subject with a celestial body.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The temporal occurrence in مِرَّةٍ and the lunar-evenness branch of استوى permit a cyclic station reading.

activation_trace.role: A bounded temporal occurrence supplies one phase in a recurrence.
The moon's even phase supplies the rare celestial sense of achieved balance.
A rising celestial body supplies the cyclic object-image.
Falling supplies the opposite phase against which stationing becomes legible.
Distant horizons supply the field across which rise, balance, and fall are mapped.

changed_reading.before: The clause only reports a powerful person's stance.
changed_reading.after: As a contained celestial overlay, it can picture a recurring appearance reaching an even horizon station between rise and fall.

strongest_changes: The preceding plural powers turn generic might into braided, load-sharing force that reaches stable completion.
The horizon-to-nearness sequence turns istawa into exact spatial calibration for a controlled approach.
The later truthfulness of heart and bounded eye recasts mirra as governance of perception between deviation and excess.
The other single descent activates a coexisting evental reading in which stationing can recur.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots support several live mechanisms at once: integrated strength, directed transit, tensile equilibrium, ordeal-tempered recovery, faithful transmission, repeatable manifestation, and poised limitation under concealment. The odd rope, bow, bodily-humor, and celestial branches changed the reading rather than merely decorating it.
remaining_uncertainties: The resultative force assigned to fa- is a reader inference; the clauses may remain more loosely sequential.
The evental mirra reading is grammatically less immediate than the strength reading even though 53:13 strongly activates recurrence.
The bow-tension, humoral, and celestial models are cross-domain overlays and should coexist with, not displace, the stronger personal-agent readings.
The later prostration may illuminate the focus posture thematically without describing the same subject or event.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Firm resolve reaching a sound configuration.** م ر ر B006 supplies bodily strength, sound mind, and resolve; س و ي B002 supplies straightness and sound completion. The sequence from possessed capacity to *fa-stawā* makes inner firmness issue in stable form. I infer that resolve enables exact self-composure; the ayah reads as capability becoming balanced manifestation.
2. **Strength rising into position.** م ر ر B006 remains the capacity, while س و ي B003 supplies rising and settling upon something. Its next location at the highest horizon (53:7) is the spatial cue. I infer that the settling is a controlled occupation of a high station; the ayah reads dynamically, as ascent into stable position.
3. **Maturity rather than momentary force.** س و ي B005 supplies reaching full maturity, and م ر ر B006 supplies sound, firm strength. Against the one-time descent language of 53:13, this pairing suggests completed capacity rather than a transient burst. I infer that reliable teaching requires mature power; the ayah reads as qualification of the teacher's developed fitness.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 53:13's discrete descent and 53:42's terminal limit make the completed stability here look like controlled readiness before movement. The later trajectory confirms that س و ي B002/B003 is stable positioning, not immobility.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Twisted firmness resolving into alignment.** `م ر ر B005` supplies tightly twisting a rope and `م ر ر B006` firm strength and resolve; these are activated by the rope-strand image of `ق و ي B001` in 53:5. `س و ي B002` then supplies internal straightness and sound completion, with the consecutive `فـ` making completion the next state. The packet gives twisted firmness followed by straight completion; I infer the mechanical arrow tension integrated -> stable alignment. The fixed ayah reads as a transition from held capacity to correctly configured stance.

2. **Taking position for the encounter.** `س و ي B003` supplies rising and settling upon something, while `س و ي B004` supplies directing oneself toward a direction. The high horizon in 53:7 and approach in 53:8-9 assign this branch the role of initial positioning. lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım tek kerelik birim ile tekrarlı kullanımı ayırır; bu kullanımlardan yalın bir hareket ya da geçiş anlamı çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir eylemin tek bir gerçekleşmesi ya da bu gerçekleşmenin zaman içinde sayılabilir bir birim oluşturmasıdır. Çoğul veya yinelemeli kullanım, eylemin birbiri ardınca birkaç kez gerçekleştiğini bildirir.

facets.statement: Bir eylemin tek gerçekleşmesi, zamanın sayılabilir bir parçası olarak ele alınır.
Aynı eylemin iki ya da daha çok kez gerçekleşmesi tekrarlı biçimlerle sayılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar tek gerçekleşme ile zamanın bir parçasını aynı sayılabilir olay biriminde buluşturur ve çoğul biçimlerin eylemin tekrarını anlattığını belirtir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odakta bir kez olma kendi başına yeterlidir ve tekrar zorunlu değildir; komşuda geri dönüş ve yeniden yapma bileşeni belirgindir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu belirli bir olay türünden türemiş dar bir kerelik anlam taşır; odak dal olay türü bakımından genel ve tekrar bakımından geniştir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal zamanı bir eylemin kaç kez gerçekleştiğine göre birimlere ayırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal olay sayısından bağımsız olarak vakit, süre ve dönem bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da gerçekleşmeleri zaman içinde konumlandıran veya ölçülebilir kılan ifadeler taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odakta temel ölçü olayın gerçekleşme sayısıdır; komşuda temel kavram olaydan bağımsız zaman aralığı veya dönemdir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tatlılığın ve hoş tadın karşıtı olan duyusal tadı, ayrıca yiyeceğin bu tada dönüşmesini açıkça dalın merkezi yapar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal duyusal tadı ve o tada dönüşmeyi kapsar; mecazî sıkıntıyı, bedensel sıvıyı veya geçip gitmeyi kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın tat niteliğini, bir şeyin bu tadı edinmesini ve bu niteliğe bağlı adlandırmaları ayrı düzeylerde tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir yiyecek, içecek veya başka tadılabilir şeyde tatlılığın ve hoş tadın karşıtı olan keskin, sevimsiz tadın bulunmasıdır. Bir şeyin bu tadı sonradan edinmesi de aynı dalın süreç kullanımıdır.

facets.statement: Tadılabilir bir şey tatlı ve hoş tadın karşıtı olan acı tada sahiptir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Acılık tatlılık ekseninde değerlendirilir; komşunun yakıcılığı ise ısı ve batma duyumuna dayanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı kötülük, ağır sıkıntı ve büyük yıkım olarak doğrular; yoksulluk ve yaşlılığı örnekler. Geçici çerçevedeki kaygı ile hastalık bu dal iddiasında yer almadığından kavram tanımına taşınmamıştır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Tanım kaynak iddiasındaki ağır sıkıntı ve yıkımla sınırlıdır; kaygı ve hastalık yalnız ayrı sözlük biriminin karşılığında gösterilir.

facets.statement: Kişinin karşılaştığı hoş olmayan ağır sıkıntı, kötülük veya büyük yıkım anlatılır.
Yoksulluk ve yaşlılık bu ağır sıkıntı sınıfının özel örnekleri olarak verilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kalıplaşmış ifadeyi ağır sıkıntı, kötülük ve büyük yıkımla açıklar; yoksulluk ile yaşlılık bu çekirdeğin somut örnekleri olarak sunulur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ipi sıkıca burma işlemini, ortaya çıkan ince ve uzun sıkı burulmuş ipi ve ipin tek tek burulmuş kollarını aynı somut yapıda birleştirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal ipin burulma işlemi ve burulmuş yapısıyla sınırlıdır; insan gücü ve kararlılık yalnız ayrı dalda benzetmeli uzantıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, ipi sıkıca burma kalıbını, burulmuş ipin adlarını ve ipin tek kolunu birbirine karıştırmadan birlikte gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Bir ipin kollarını birbirine sıkıca burarak sağlam bir ip oluşturma işlemi ve bu işlemle ortaya çıkan sıkı burulmuş iptir. İpi oluşturan tek bir burulmuş kol da bu yapının parçası olarak adlandırılır.

facets.statement: İpin kolları sıkıca birbirine burularak sağlam bir bütün oluşturulur.
İnce, uzun ve sıkı burulmuş ipin kendisi işlemin sonucu olarak adlandırılır.
İpi meydana getiren tek bir burulmuş kol, bütün yapının kurucu parçasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar sıkı burmayı çekirdek işlem sayar; burulmuş ipin kendisini, sıkı burulma derecesini ve ipi oluşturan tek kolları bu işlemden türeyen görünümler olarak verir.

channel_review.note: first-pass blind review by a single reader; no adjudication, no accept/reject, no per-ayah channel maturity. Not a channel ledger.

channel_generated_outputs.note: Generated network-v3 channel discovery/family/path outputs are available as external quran-data files; read them only when channel detail is necessary, and do not treat them as an adjudicated channel ledger.

full_context_packet.note: surah-scope fallback: the default commentary workflow does not consume per-ayah focus packets, so the source packet is scoped by this builder to roots this ayah can justify and carries no staged reveal order

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_reader_responses.note: Per-ayah focus-run reader responses are retired from the default commentary workflow. Use regular reader walks, plus/minus-5 reader walks, and cross-run publication findings for corpus-wide reader-derived evidence.

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.
